operations.name: Abu Agila Mohammad Mas’ud Kheir Al-Marimi

expected.charges: Destruction of aircraft resulting in death; original indictment also charged destruction of a vehicle used in foreign commerce by an explosive resulting in death. Federal Lockerbie bombing prosecution, 1:22-cr-00392-DLF
expected.sentence: Pretrial detention; not guilty plea; no conviction or sentence. U.S. custody began in December 2022; December 12 court appearance and Alexandria booking are documented, but exact transfer/arrest date is not assigned. August 31, 2026 reporting confirms Alexandria detention location. Trial postponed in August 2026 following newly disclosed evidence; September reporting targets January 2027 without a final confirmed schedule. Life imprisonment is a potential maximum, not an imposed sentence. Sources: https://www.justice.gov/usao-dc/pr/pan-am-flight-103-terrorist-suspect-custody-1988-bombing-over-lockerbie-scotland ; https://abcnews.com/US/pan-103-bombing-case-suspect-appears-court/story?id=95066207 ; https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/31/what-to-know-us-court-hearing-held-for-alleged-lockerbie-bombmaker ; https://apnews.com/article/e075ea7e4b31767be8698173832e73fb ; https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/09/27/lockerbie-suspect-trial-abu-agila/

operations.research_note: Primary government motion Dkt.23 pp4-5 records November 29, 2022 indictment; p10 lists case prosecutors, excluding supervisory U.S. Attorney. Primary Dkt.82 p27 signed Dabney L. Friedrich: https://www.justice.gov/usao-dc/media/1382911/dl?inline= . Motion also expressly states December 11, 2022 transfer into U.S. custody, a newly verified endpoint for future reconciliation of existing month-level dates and contradictory legacy sentence prose; existing populated dates and sentence preserved in this missing-only pass. No trial outcome or release inferred.
